title: Open and Overlapping Referrals for One Specialty — Referrals & Prior Authorizations Intake Rule
content:
For one referral type and one specialty, a patient may hold at most the type's number of open Referrals & Prior Authorizations cases, as set in the intake criteria. An open case is one in status requested, submitted, approved or appealed, counted on the handling date across the patient's cases of the same type and specialty.

## Intake clauses

1. **Open-case limit.** A new request of a type for a specialty may be opened only while the patient's count of open cases of that type and specialty is below the type's limit.
2. **No pending case of the same kind.** The patient holds no other referral of the same tier and specialty in status requested, submitted or appealed. This is read from the group's referral records for this patient, this referral type and this specialty, whichever rendering provider the other case names; the patient's own account of pending cases does not replace the record.
3. **Duplicate after an approval.** A new request for the same specialty made within the type's duplicate window after an approval whose units remain is a duplicate and is not opened; the existing referral is used or extended instead.
4. **Standing and HMO referrals exclude each other.** A Standing Specialist Referral and an HMO Specialist Referral for the same specialty are mutually exclusive. When a standing referral is approved, any approved HMO Specialist Referral for that specialty is cancelled with the reason superseded and its unused units lapse, and a new HMO Specialist Referral is not opened while the standing referral is approved.
5. **Out-of-network after in-network.** An Out-of-Network Referral is not opened while an approved in-network referral of the same specialty still has units.
6. **Imaging and procedures are per ordered service.** Imaging and procedure authorizations are per ordered service, so two authorizations of the same type may be open for two different ordered services, up to the type's limit.
7. **Standing referrals need a documented condition.** A Standing Specialist Referral is requested only where a chronic or complex condition is documented, as that type requires.

## Clause 1 and clause 2 side by side (hypothetical cases)

| Existing cases of the same type and specialty | Count of open cases | Type's limit | Clause 1 | Any of them requested, submitted or appealed? | Clause 2 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| none | 0 | 1 | met | no | met |
| one approved case | 1 | 1 | not met | no | met |
| one approved imaging authorization for a different ordered service | 1 | 2 | met | no | met |
| one submitted case | 1 | 2 | met | yes | not met |

## Points of judgement

- *A patient's approved HMO Specialist Referral for neurology still has units when a Standing Specialist Referral for neurology is approved.* The HMO referral is cancelled as superseded and its unused units lapse.
- *A patient with an approved in-network orthopedics referral that still has visits asks for an out-of-network orthopedist.* An Out-of-Network Referral is not opened while that in-network referral still has units.
